components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: GHands is a mobile product surface — not a marketing site. The interface should feel like a capable local service app: warm light content areas, sage olive brand moments on hero panels and primary actions, and Poppins typography tuned for legibility at arm's length.
keyCharacteristics: Sage olive (#4F6739) as the sole brand accent
Warm neutrals instead of cold gray UI fills
Flat Android elevation; restrained iOS shadows

rules.name: The Sage Signal Rule
rules.body: Sage accent appears on primary CTAs, active navigation, and intentional hero panels — never as a full-screen wash on data-heavy screens.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Prefer #F3F4F6 and #F5F0E8 over cold grays. The app should feel local and human, not clinical.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce Inter, system UI, or display serifs for UI chrome. Poppins only.

rules.name: The Flat Android Rule
rules.body: Never add elevation on Android for decorative depth. Use borders and background contrast instead.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Prefer rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.055–0.12) borders over dark box shadows for card separation.

dos: Do import colors, spacing, and typography from @/lib/designSystem
Do use SURFACE_STYLES for card elevation on iOS
Do keep primary sage CTAs to one per screen section
Do provide skeleton loaders and empty states for async content
Do use 200–300ms animation durations for state feedback
donts: Don't use generic AI SaaS aesthetics — purple gradients, glassmorphism, neon accents
Don't nest cards inside cards without clear hierarchy
Don't add heavy Android elevation or dark drop shadows
Don't use pure black backgrounds or untinted cold grays
Don't use bounce or elastic easing
Don't invent custom affordances when standard mobile patterns exist
